license_policy: Three CC0 independent water, stream and ocean field recordings; verification source links included; original WAV source is NOT downloaded
media_quality_policy: Public Freesound HQ MP3 previews are lossy; actual bitrate varies and the first 28MB of any long preview cannot establish its true full-file bitrate. The 192 kbps audition MP3 is a transcoding step and cannot restore quality. Do not publish without listening approval; original lossless WAV recordings remain separate.
goal: Three P0 distinct Rivers, Water and Ocean first-wave audition masters. Review only; no production source IDs or SEO URL promotion

tracks.title: Rushing River — Magdalena River, Los Dinamos

tracks.notes: Strong actual river recorded at Magdalena River in Los Dinamos near Mexico City with Zoom H5N; loud flow, stereo. Check bass, occasional human activity and source difference.

limitations: Original lossless source NOT downloaded; publicly accessible HQ preview is lossy
Review listening needed: source identity, tonality, abrupt events, peak, physical listening comfort, 10min loop
